dict.string: Faith listens while you hold the screen, and during a booking conversation, so you can ask for an object or a ticket.
Faith uses the camera to find the objects you ask for. A picture is sent only after you say yes or hold the screen to send it.
Faith turns what you say while holding the screen into text, on this iPhone, to know what you asked for.
Faith uses your AirPods' motion so the sound stays where the object is when you turn your head. Motion stays on this iPhone and never confirms anything.
Connect to your Faith development backend on your local network.
